name: protein phosphatase 2 scaffold subunit Aalpha
pathways: RNA polymerase II transcription initiation surveillance

function.text: PPP2R1A encodes serine/threonine-protein phosphatase 2A 65 kDa regulatory subunit A alpha isoform. Annotated molecular activities include protein heterodimerization activity and protein phosphatase regulator activity. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and RNA polymerase II transcription initiation surveillance.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant); Houge-Janssens syndrome 2 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Serous carcinoma of endometrium; Carcinosarcoma of female genital tract. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

function.text: PPP2R1A encodes serine/threonine-protein phosphatase 2A 65 kDa regulatory subunit A alpha isoform. Based in part on similarity, the PR65 subunit of protein phosphatase 2A serves as a scaffolding molecule to coordinate the assembly of the catalytic subunit and a variable regulatory B subunit. It is required for proper chromosome segregation and for centromeric localization of SGO1 in mitosis. Dephosphorylation of AKT1 is essential for regulatory T-cells (Treg) homeostasis and stability.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant); Houge-Janssens syndrome 2 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PPP2R1A have been reported in serous carcinoma of endometrium, carcinosarcoma of female genital tract, and endometrial carcinoma.
